values.name: AMEND_REJECTED
values.doc: An amend was refused; the order is unchanged.

values.name: REPLACE_REJECTED
values.doc: A replace's successor was refused; the original order is unchanged.

values.name: REJECTED
values.doc: An order was refused before it existed, such as a duplicate.

values.name: CANCEL_ALL_DONE
values.doc:
A cancel by criteria completed; its cancels came earlier as order
 events. It names no request: with several cancels by criteria in
 flight, a client cannot tell which one completed.
